findings.trigger: A maintainer reads the HARD_MIN declaration while reasoning about the newly added sealed-pocket path.
findings.consequence: The comment falsely states that 0.45 m is the closest possible camera distance even though the new resolver intentionally allows smaller distances and clips the avatar with the near plane, which can mislead future maintenance or regression-test design.
findings.evidence: Line 310 says HARD_MIN is the closest the camera ever gets, while changed lines 374-381 omit HARD_MIN from the resolved t and explicitly handle t * len below HARD_MIN.
findings.rule: Comments describing invariants must remain consistent with the behavior implemented by the adjacent code.
